say:1:1033144001:1.text: Looking for something to eat, obviously! Is there anything more important than filling your belly?
say:1:1033144001:1.source_cn: 当然是在找能吃的东西！现在这情况，还有什么比填饱肚子更...
say:1:1033144001:1.male: Looking for something to eat, obviously! Is there anything more important than filling your belly?
say:1:1033144001:1.female: Looking for something to eat, obviously! Is there anything more important than filling your belly?

say:2:1033144002:1.text: There are lots of mouths to feed, but few people can help. Many of them were injured while traveling, so I have to gather even more food.
say:2:1033144002:1.source_cn: 吃饭的嘴多，干活的人少，像我这种壮年人就更少了，还有不...
say:2:1033144002:1.male: There are lots of mouths to feed, but few people can help. Many of them were injured while traveling, so I have to gather even more food.
say:2:1033144002:1.female: There are lots of mouths to feed, but few people can help. Many of them were injured while traveling, so I have to gather even more food.

say:3:1033144003:1.text: See that bush, laden with berries? That's what I'm after.
say:3:1033144003:1.source_cn: 看到那丛挂满浆果的灌木没？那就是我的目标。
say:3:1033144003:1.male: See that bush, laden with berries? That's what I'm after.
say:3:1033144003:1.female: See that bush, laden with berries? That's what I'm after.

say:4:1033144004:1.text: But there are quite a few crazy gruglins nearby. I need to wait for them to leave; otherwise... I can't even guarantee my own safety.
say:4:1033144004:1.source_cn: 不过那旁边有好几只发狂的咕布林，我得等他们离开，要不然...
